requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready seamless PBR base-color/albedo texture for timber inns in a calm rounded Unreal Engine game-art snowy hot-spring village. Generate ONE square, edge-to-edge, truly tileable texture of a single continuous warm cedar timber surface, straight-on orthographic, not a scene or object. Wood fibers run consistently vertically from top to bottom. Many fine irregular longitudinal fibers, a few understated elongated natural grain contours, occasional tiny subtle knots; warm honey/chestnut brown midtones with restrained color variation. The surface is well-maintained weathered timber, not damaged, no deep cracks. The texture will cover about two metres of beam length and two metres across; fine grain must read gracefully when tiled and on narrow posts. Flat unlit diffuse albedo, uniform neutral illumination, no cast shadows, no highlights, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no baked directional lighting. Gentle stylized realism with restrained detail, no painterly strokes. Do not show separate planks, board borders, seams, gaps, black stripes, repetitive sine waves, concentric rings, parquet, perspective, bevels, labels, text, logos, watermarks, or a swatch border. All four edges must wrap seamlessly. Full square image is only the material.
requests.visual_inspection: Inspected original flat albedo and real UE repeated close surfaces. Raw edge mismatch is measured in image_source_analysis; mirror addressing reverses motifs/slopes. No bitmap editing.
requests.surface_mapping: Wood/DarkWood 2.5m component grain UV; deterministic caps and bent centerlines

requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept.
